## Intent

Port `src/infrastructure/world` callers onto the approved host world repositories: all 17 world/atlas/place RPCs plus profile CRUD and map-pin/atlas asset storage remain available through host ports, without production cutover or Supabase shutdown.

## Acceptance tier

`isolated-contract` — SLICE DONE when Required Tests PASS on host ports + infra contract. FEATURE VERIFIED deferred to ATLAS-LIVE-E2E/#770 + MIG-602/#847. RELEASE APPROVED never implied.

## Preconditions

- MIG-012/#791 world read port, MIG-013/#792 policy, MIG-020/#795 HTTP, MIG-014/#793 auth, MIG-500/#841 assets, and world/atlas RPC children (#861–#866) are DONE on `main`.
- Host `createWorldPorts` + application command wrappers exist for all 17 RPCs.
- Frontend Supabase adapters remain the live production path until an explicit cutover ticket.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Create world/node/maps; edit/rename/reparent/duplicate/archive/delete with consequence preview and reload into DB-backed tree via host ports.
- [ ] Player sees only explicitly revealed map/place projection for the selected saga; owner without GM privileges follows per-RPC policy (DENY, not silent UI hide).
- [ ] Map pin upload uses host asset storage (not a table); media `map-pin` profile validates; all 17 RPC deps + profile CRUD transport ready on host before facade cutover.
- [ ] Contract fixtures for each of the 17 RPCs: caller args/defaults and result/error union reachable from host `WorldPorts` + `application/commands/*` wrappers; unauthorized and reload cases covered in self-test.
- [ ] Infra `HostWorldPorts` contract mirrors host DTO/error unions without importing `server/`; Supabase services stay wired (no production cutover).
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout).

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Stranger / non-member / missing actor → DENY (`not-authorized` / `42501` / `missing-actor`) with no private projection leak.
- [ ] Empty / blank world or map ids fail closed (no owner-bound widen).
- [ ] Map-pin / atlas bytes go through `assets.publish` (or documented bucket successor), never inserted as rows in world tables.
- [ ] Invalid map-pin MIME/size rejected by host media policy before publish.
